Generate a detailed Markdown summary of the code changes on this branch with the following sections:

- Purpose
- How it works
- Code changes
  - For each changed file that isn't a test, include:
    - File name, hyperlinked to GitHub if the GitHub branch is up to date
    - Change size (e.g., `(+5,–6)`)
    - A description of what the change does
- Test changes
  - For each changed test file, include:
    - File name, hyperlinked to GitHub if the GitHub branch is up to date
    - Change size (e.g., `(+5,–6)`)
    - A description of what the change does

This is meant to be a high-level summary to save time for reviewers, so be brief.

Write the output to `.gv-review/summary.md`. If the file already exists, replace it — the pre-existing contents are no longer useful.
